reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual re-review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution profile crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; prior external-01 review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The source visibly has a dark profile-side eyebrow beneath the visor, while external-02 leaves the brow area above the visible eye completely smooth. Restore that source-scale dark eyebrow while preserving the successfully repaired two-row note and near-profile pose.
entries.positive_observation: The note repair is successful: exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows remain, with two gray groups per row, no third row or lower-left dash, and largely blank lower paper. The subject remains the yellow mascot in a viewer-left near-profile, with one firm closed mouth and no glasses or added beard. The dark olive cap retains gold piping/front decoration and the bright pale visor reflection. Red/gold collar details, the prominent gold shoulder board and pale/red ribbon with a silver-toned detail remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar. The complete tilted frame, darker opaque gray-olive backing, warm-cream note and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The missing dark eyebrow is the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: The narrow upper-lip detail, exact cap/neck insignia and fine temple/nape hair edge are not fully separable at source scale or beneath the cap; none is used as an additional rejection reason. The absent profile-side dark eyebrow is clearly visible in the native crop.
